regions.merged_text: In conclusion, while I trust the above may offend no one, I would call attention in a very practical advice of a former president of the F.O. I. F., the dear Carmelite Father McGinnis, now General of his whole Order. "The moment a man or a machine or an organization or a clique gets bigger than the cause, get away from any or all of them because they have ceased to be of any good and have begun to do harm no matter what the past record of any or all of them be." Coming from Rome where they were written January 1, 1920, these words have the ring of at least a foresight of what many an honest member of the F.O. I.F. has taken as a kind of personal matter of thought as is manifested from the multitudes of their brethren of the A.A.R.I.R. May God bless the honest members of both with a sense of unsel- fish justice and consistency and unaffected charity. And may He bless every honest reader of the Irish World and Industrial Liber- ator!
